parsed.impact: Described.meet is now Option<bool> and the model's schema and prompt make it nullable, which touches the US-10-02 reading path and tests and the TC-10-18/19 test set (a real model may now answer null where it said false). Editor gained `unresolved` (a new list in the guests section, ignored on save). The sync engine gained a separate Named lookup job, leaving the guest field's Suggest/people path untouched.

findings.text: crates/app/src/editor.rs:267 — MOD-10-F12, story scenario 2 and TC-10-22 say the guest field holds the uncertain names, with "the usual suggestions" for Zenek. The implementation lists them under the field and shows "No one found" for a name nobody fits (DEC-225, a loop decision). A reader of the spec expects different UI → the analyst confirms DEC-225 or amends F12 and TC-10-22.

crates/app/src/main.rs:2051 — Edge case "account cannot add Meet → switch stays off and unavailable" is not built (DEC-226, a loop decision). Described Meet=true on such an account turns the switch on, and the event is saved without a call and the user is told → the analyst accepts DEC-226, or the editor greys the switch in a later story.

crates/app/src/sync.rs:971 — When the account has no session, or Google errors or is unreachable while `online` is still true, `Named` returns an empty list per name (`unwrap_or_default`). Every name then shows "not invited — pick who you mean / No one found", indistinguishable from "nobody fits". The guest field behaves the same → acceptable; optionally treat a failed lookup like offline and leave the names out.

crates/app/src/main.rs:2463 — The Google answer for a lookup is taken even if events from a description were turned off in the settings meanwhile; `read()` drops answers in that case but this path does not. Scenario: send a description naming guests, open the settings (which waits for the answer), turn the feature off, close the settings → the editor still opens → check `self.settings.ollama.on` before `open_described`, or clear `named` when the feature is switched off.

crates/core/src/described.rs:182 — When a name matches only a person already invited or the user's own address, `suggestions` returns empty. The name is then listed as "No one found" even though the person is invited → drop such a name silently, or say it is already invited.

crates/app/src/main.rs:2091 — `open_described` clones the account's recent guests for every name and uses `account.unwrap_or_default()` inside the closure. Simpler: compute `recent` once outside the `map`. Harmless at this size.
crates/app/src/sync.rs:757 — `Update::Named` overwrites `named` and nothing clears it on Esc or on a new `look_up`. Harmless today; clearing `sync.named` in `look_up` would make it airtight.

criteria.note: names are searched through the same `session.people` as the guest field, plus recent guests; TC-10-21 covers the contacts, directory and recent sources. The real Google contacts and directory are the owner's manual check.
`Described::full()` routes guests or Meet to the full editor, anything else to the "New event" window; TC-10-20 asserts it.
TC-10-23 covers all four rows, checking both editor state and the switch's accessibility toggle state.
TC-10-24 asserts a local editor with no guests, no switch and no guest field, and no Google traffic.
TC-10-25 case A (offline) and case B (no account).
